about_the_game:
Welcome to College Story!

"College Story" is a college themed simulation business love development game, you will play a freshman, four years of college life. Here, your college is your oyster!

The changes of The Times have left the traces of time on the faces of the family. Your grandparents' lives are different, your parents' lives are different, and your life is different. There may be a certain generation gap in thinking, but there is no doubt that your family is the biggest supporter on your way to growth. Here, you can feel the kinship between three generations.

College roommates should be the people you spend the most time with in your four years of college. You study together, you hack together, you brag together...... They come from various provinces and cities, different personalities, each has its own characteristics. Here, learn their stories and experience the friendship between brothers.

In college, you will meet the person in your life. Here, you can understand their stories, choose to become their blue confidant or the other half, talk about a sweet love.

There are nearly 30 different scenes inside and outside the game, each scene has its own random events, but also because of your training route and some choices, produce new random events. Total number of random events over 600!!

After four years of college, you will get different life endings according to your chosen major, the score of four years of college, your own attributes and talents, whether to take the postgraduate exam, choose the girlfriend and other conditions, a total of 100+ different life endings waiting for you to unlock.

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains small amounts of sexual innuendo and conversation, as well as some nudity such as swimsuit characters. The game contains minor depictions of alcohol consumption, mild foul language, and occasional cursing.

short_description: "University Story" is a college simulation game where you play as a freshman. Experience family, friendship, and love over four years in university. How will you balance studying, socializing, and daily life? What kind of person will you become ? Every choice you make shapes your future!
